prefill_rows.comparison_caveat: Baseline predates reboot and charger change. Same fixed requests and engine; finalists require matched-power and full-agent verification.

power_caveat: Historical measurements lack complete charger/thermal controls; battery assistance occurred in the campaign. Treat small differences as unconfirmed.

resident_session_cache.limits: One cold/warm pair on the same resident dense model and synthetic repair. The cold result includes process loading; warm does not. No idle unload or server restart between sessions. This does not yet prove persistence across model unload/reload or a charger-controlled speedup.
